title: Sofia’s Golden Streets: A Tour of the Historical Capital’s Highlights
description: A walk along the yellow-brick boulevards from Alexander Nevsky Cathedral past the old royal palace, the parliament, and the Russian church to the Roman ruins of Serdica and the Largo.
creator: Vania Todorova

title: Hidden Sofia: A Guide to the Ancient Capital and Its Modern Highlights
description: A walk from Sveta Nedelya Square past the Rotunda of St. George, the synagogue and mosque of the “Square of Tolerance,” and the presidency to Alexander Nevsky Cathedral.
creator: Yulia Lukova

title: Mineral Springs, Ruins, and Communist Echoes: A Guide to Sofia’s Roots
description: A longer walk from the National Palace of Culture through the center, past the mineral springs, the Banya Bashi mosque, and the Roman ruins, to Alexander Nevsky Cathedral.
creator: Heidi Nicklaus
